title.narrative: Gender Equality in Economic Rights Activity

description.narrative: Lesotho - Private Sector Development Project - Gender Equality in Economic Rights Activity: In December 2006, the Government passed into law the Legal Capacity of Married Persons Act which removes the minority status of married women. With assistance from MCC, the Government has already contracted for two related activities: a gender review of laws and policies with recommendations for reform, and the development of a training and public outreach program to realize in practice gender equality in economic rights. The first sub activity is a training program to promulgate the Legal Capacity of Married Persons Act and other reforms aimed at gender equality in the economy. The second sub activity is a public awareness and outreach program designed to develop knowledge, awareness and practices in support of these economic rights.
Capital of Lesotho, Maseru

condition.narrative: Further details on conditions precedent affecting this activity can be found in the top-level parent activities.

MCC will have approved all aspects of the implementation design that results from World Bank funded feasibility study, including but not limited to, ESA review to assure that the NIDC program is safeguarded against human rights abuses and is compliant with the MCC Gender Policy.
The Ministry of Gender will have designated a full-time, qualified expert to act as the focal point for the implementation of the training and public awareness campaign for women's economic rights.

The head of environmental and social assessment for MCA-Lesotho and the social/gender specialist will review TORs for feasibility and design work for private sector development activities, including the National ID Card, Credit Bureau, and Land Policy Reform activities, to ensure compliance with MCC Gender Policy and to mitigate against any potential adverse social or environmental impacts that may occur as a result of intervention.
